scope: Existing tiny MoE HF component results on Radeon and MI50. Records aggregate maxima, bounds and conservative headroom, plus the code-derived comparison count. It does not claim individual per-case deltas were retained.

coverage.logits: 2 thread counts (1,4) x 5 ubatches (1,2,3,5,16) x 5 prompts = 50 full-vocabulary comparisons
coverage.nll: 2 thread counts x 2 frozen perplexity cases (contexts 4 and 16) = 4 checks
coverage.additional: Draft checks run after HF comparisons. Each HF CLI call emits an actual matrix-path record consumed by common.hf_bounds; only the selected bound set, not per-call paths, is retained in suite logs.

hf.rounding_note: Max errors are printed to 8 decimal places; conservative headroom subtracts 5e-9 for display rounding.
hf.per_case_detail: Per-case values are not retained by check_hf_fixture. It checks every case and retains only the maximum.

q8_notes.gated: Per-prompt/mode maxima, signed NLL deltas and top-ID counts are preserved from logs. The test checks the dynamically selected bounds for every gated prompt/mode; numeric bound and actual per-call path are not present in summary logs, so no numeric headroom is asserted here.
q8_notes.near_tie: Sensitivity-only; tests/moe.py applies no numerical bound, so no headroom or pass claim.

limitations: Per-case logit/NLL errors are not retained; the receipt gives the aggregate maximum across each complete fixture loop.
Actual matrix-path records are consumed by common.hf_bounds but not preserved per invocation.
Radeon whole device suite exited 1 for unrelated missing-component/tool failures; its moe component itself passed.
MI50 receipt covers the isolated moe component only.
Q8 near-tie is diagnostic with no bound.
